note: The fixture under fixture/ is a small Java tree in two states; make-fixture.sh commits base/ then head/ into a temporary repository so the pre-pass and the finders run on a real diff_ref (HEAD~1..HEAD). head/ seeds one defect per chosen card and, beside each, a control whose suspicious-looking code is correct by a stated tolerance. expected.json lists the (rule_id, file, symbol) triple per seed and the rule ids that must stay silent per control; grade.py grades the run's verdicts.json against it.

assertion_kinds.seed: a verified finding must carry the seed's rule_id — as its own or folded into it by aggregation (`also`) — and the seed's file, and its symbol's method part must match
assertion_kinds.control: no verified finding with a listed rule id may sit on the control's file and symbol

grading.counting_rule: A finding counts when its disposition after verification is report, flagged or downgraded; a finding a skeptic rejected (or an arbiter upheld as rejected) does not. --findings adds the pre-verification hits so a control the finder flagged and the skeptic rejected is visible as 'flagged then rejected'.
grading.matcher: Exact rule_id and file; symbol compared on the part after the last '#', '.' or '::', case-insensitive, '()' stripped.
grading.why_mechanical: Precision and recall on seeded defects need no reading: the triple either appears in the verified set or it does not. A judge model would add its own error to the measurement and the self-preference bias of a Claude judge on Claude findings (Zheng 2306.05685). Holistic quality of a finding's prose is not graded here.

runner.review: Workflow({ scriptPath: scripts/review-workflow.js, args: { root: <dir>, stage: 'all', plan: <dir>/review/plan.json, design_intent, project_context } })

subject.note: The models under test are the workflow's own tiers (args.tiers in SKILL.md §Phase 4). Re-run this harness on every model change; a minor model bump silently dropped one rule's compliance by 48% in the audit skill's evidence base (Yang 2505.13360 §3.3).

judge.why: Grading is mechanical on (rule_id, file, symbol) triples; no judge model runs.

satisfied: Mechanical grading on triples: no holistic score, no judge model, no self-preference channel.
Controls present for every seeded card: each seed sits beside a control whose tolerance the card's Limits name, so a finder that fires on the pattern alone fails the control.
Verification exercised: one control (Stats#sample) is correct only by a project_context tolerance, which the finder cannot see as code, so the skeptic path is on the grading path.
Pre-pass exercised on a real repository: make-fixture.sh commits two states, so hunk parsing, trigger selection, slicing and config parsing run as in production.
Subject tiers pinned with the pin dated; re-run on model change.

unsatisfied.why: Each grading run is a single run of the workflow; no variance figure has been measured for the seeds. A finder that flags a seed in 9 runs of 10 and a control in 1 of 10 grades identically to a deterministic one on a single run.
unsatisfied.unblock: Run the workflow N times on the fixture and report pass rate per seed and per control.

unsatisfied.why: The grading runs the Workflow path. The Agent-tool fallback (one sub-agent per domain) bundles a domain's cards into one agent and has not been graded on the fixture.
unsatisfied.unblock: Run the fallback dispatch on the fixture with the same prompts and schemas and grade its verdicts.

unsatisfied.why: The plugin's agent types (code-quality:review-finder, code-quality:review-verifier) resolve only where the plugin is installed; the recorded runs dispatched the default workflow sub-agent with the same prompts.
unsatisfied.unblock: Re-run the harness in a session with the plugin installed and agentTypes set.

constraints.standing_caveat: A seed found on the fixture is a finder that recognises one shape of the defect; a control silent on the fixture is one tolerance recognised. Neither measures recall on real diffs.

runs.result: 13/13 passed: 6 seeds found, 7 controls silent after verification
runs.raw_finder_hits: 6/6 seeds hit by their cards; 0/7 controls flagged by any card before verification; the logic pass added two findings of its own
runs.notes: CC-08's finding and the PROJ-1 finding shared the span Cache#getOrLoad with compatible fixes and were folded into PROJ-1.1 (also: CC-08), which the grader counts for the seed. The skeptic downgraded CC-11.1 to minor. The logic pass found a genuine defect the fixture did not seed on purpose — Totals#transfer credits the target without debiting the source — and the skeptic confirmed it critical; its second finding on Totals#addWithinLimit was rejected. The fixture tree was unmutated after the run (git status clean but for review/).
runs.agents: 12 finders (6 card jobs, 3 logic slices, 3 project-invariant jobs) + 8 skeptics; no second skeptic or arbiter was needed
runs.cost: Find stage 600,995 sub-agent tokens in 96 s wall-clock; full run (finders replayed from cache) 579,754 further tokens in 888 s at the runtime's two-agent concurrency cap on a 4-CPU host
